items.description: An Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code/Codex as an AI collaborator in your vault
The world's best AI personal assistant for email. Open source app to help you reach inbox zero fast.
Get tasks and ideas out of your head. A free GTD to-do app for desktop and mobile. Works offline, no account needed
An open-source, cross OS, community-driven launcher. A lightweight alternative to Spotlight and Raycast. Made with ❤️ from Viet Nam 🇻🇳
Stop letting your work go unnoticed. Meridian keeps an automatic work journal of what you worked on and what you finished, summarised daily, and automatically drafts your project tickets for you.
Wishes in, PRs out. CLI agent that interviews you, plans the work, dispatches parallel agents in isolated worktrees, and reviews code before you see it.
A curated list of 450+ awesome open-source alternatives to proprietary SaaS. Deployment configs, self-hosting guides, and tool directory.
Catrace: Every notify is a Plugin! Catrace 是一个桌面小窗系统，由插件决定小窗的展示方式与交互形式。 VSCode 提供代码视窗，插件提供能力；Catrace 提供小窗视窗，插件提供内容。久坐提醒是 Catrace 的首个插件，未来还将有更多能力以插件的形式接入。
ERD Builder Pro is a database design and documentation tool for developers. Build ERDs, flowcharts, notes, and drawings — all in one workspace
The control plane for your AI employees

Free, sub-second on-device AI dictation for macOS. Dual engines (Whisper + Parakeet) on Apple Silicon. Optional AI polish on your Mac with EG-1 or S1-mini by Superwhisper, Apple Intelligence (macOS 26), Ollama, or your own OpenAI/Gemini/Claude key. Snippets, custom words, no account, no subscription, audio never leaves your Mac.
轻量、高效、开源的 Windows 启动器
Spotlight-style local search for everything you saved and forgot: GitHub stars, local files, images, and bookmarks. Privacy-first, no full-disk scanning, fully on-device.
Automate your job: local-first AI task hub. Email, Teams, Slack & reports -> one timeline -> AI triage -> your coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) do the work, you approve.
Personal Context Manager for Claude Code. Your life in walnuts.
